description: This file defines an HTTP server for serving OpenID Connect metadata and JSON Web Key Sets (JWKS) related to Kubernetes Service Account tokens, including server setup, route configuration, and response handlers.

classes.name: OpenIDMetadataServer
classes.description: A server that provides OpenID configuration and JWKS endpoints for Kubernetes Service Accounts.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Adds the OpenIDMetadataServer routes to the given restful container.

methods.name: serveConfiguration
methods.description: Handles requests for the OpenID configuration JSON, returning the configuration data with appropriate headers.

methods.name: serveKeys
methods.description: Handles requests for the JWKS JSON, returning the key set with appropriate headers.
